# RYZE Cleaning Services

## About

RYZE Cleaning Services is a locally owned window and exterior cleaning company based in Pleasant Grove, Utah. We serve residential and commercial customers across Utah County and Salt Lake County. 5.0 stars on Google. 500+ homes cleaned.

## Services and Pricing

- **Exterior Window Cleaning** — Full home exterior, all windows and frames, post-clean inspection before departure. Most full-home exteriors completed in 2–4 hours. Pricing by window count; free quote required.
- **Interior Window Cleaning** — All interior glass, sills, tracks, and frames. Sliding glass doors and French doors included. Pet- and child-safe solutions only. Pricing by scope; free quote required.
- **Interior & Exterior Package** — Combined service at a discount vs. booking separately.
- **Commercial Window Cleaning** — Office parks, multi-unit properties, post-construction cleans. Scheduled recurring contracts available. Flexible after-hours scheduling. Pricing by property size and window count.
- **Post-Construction Cleans** — New builds and move-in commercial cleans.

All quotes are free and typically returned same day.

## Locations

Based in Pleasant Grove, Utah. Serves Utah County and Salt Lake County.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What areas do you serve?**
Utah County and Salt Lake County. Cities include Pleasant Grove, Provo, Orem, Lehi, American Fork, Springville, Spanish Fork, Draper, Sandy, South Jordan, West Jordan, Murray, and surrounding areas. Call or text (385) 484-2546 to confirm your city.

**How much does window cleaning cost?**
Residential exterior pricing is based on window count. Interior pricing is based on scope. Most customers get a same-day quote after submitting a request at ryzecleaning.com or texting (385) 484-2546. Booking interior and exterior together typically costs less than booking them separately.

**How long does a cleaning take?**
Most full-home exterior jobs take 2–4 hours. Interior or combined interior and exterior jobs vary by home size.

**Do I need to be home during the cleaning?**
For exterior-only jobs, you don't need to be home — just ensure access to all sides of the house. For interior cleaning, an adult must be present during the service.

**Are you insured?**
Yes. RYZE carries comprehensive liability insurance on every job, protecting your home and property.

**Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?**
Yes. If you're not satisfied with the results, we return at no charge to make it right. The job isn't complete until you're happy.

**How often should windows be cleaned?**
Most Utah homes benefit from 2–4 cleanings per year. Spring and fall are the most popular. Homes near dusty roads, with pools, or with heavy foliage may benefit from more frequent service.

**How do I get a quote?**
Call or text (385) 484-2546, email cleanwithryze@gmail.com, or submit the form at ryzecleaning.com. Most quotes come back the same day.
